metadata.title: Results from TALIS Starting Strong 2024: Strengthening Early Childhood Education and Care

survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This OECD TALIS Starting Strong 2024 report is based on a large-scale international survey of early childhood education and care (ECEC) staff and leaders. The report describes the survey as internationally comparable and produced through collaboration with participating countries/subnational entities and an international implementation consortium, implying a complex sampling design typical of TALIS Starting Strong. However, the provided excerpt does not specify whether complex survey weights (e.g., student/staff sampling weights) or replicate weights (e.g., BRR/jackknife) were applied in the analyses reported here, nor does it name any weight variables. For analysts using the underlying TALIS Starting Strong microdata, the standard practice is to apply the provided sampling weights and, where available, replicate weights to obtain correct standard errors under the complex design; this report excerpt does not provide enough detail to confirm the exact weighting variables used.

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: The excerpt does not describe any plausible-value (PV) based cognitive achievement outcomes or PV generation/combining procedures. TALIS Starting Strong is primarily a survey of staff and leaders’ reports and system/working conditions in ECEC, and the excerpted results focus on workforce experiences (e.g., job satisfaction, perceived recognition) and reported practices rather than PV-based achievement scales. Because the document excerpt does not specify a missing-data strategy for any quantitative modeling, missing-data handling cannot be extracted from the provided text.

sample_details.sample_filtering_criteria: Used the full available TALIS Starting Strong 2024 survey sample for the participating countries and subnational entities; the provided excerpt does not report the analytic inclusion/exclusion rules or any task/module completion filters.

data.outcome_summary: This OECD report presents descriptive and comparative results from TALIS Starting Strong 2024, the second round of the Starting Strong Teaching and Learning International Survey focused on early childhood education and care (ECEC). The report summarizes patterns in ECEC workforce practices and supports for children (including social and emotional development and the frequency of intentional literacy/numeracy support), as well as staff experiences such as job satisfaction, commitment to improving children’s lives, and perceived recognition by families versus society. It also highlights system-level challenges including staff shortages, stress, and constraints on collaboration and professional development time. The excerpt does not provide technical details on sampling frame, analytic subsample restrictions, or any model-based performance metrics, and it does not indicate the use of machine learning or predictive modeling. Therefore, the findings should be interpreted as survey-based evidence about ECEC workforce conditions and reported practices rather than as ML-driven causal estimates.
data.null_fields_interpretation: The provided text is an OECD report front-matter and narrative overview (preface/foreword) and does not include the methodological sections needed to extract an analytic sample size, country-level Ns, plausible-value handling, missing-data procedures, or any ML modeling approach. It also does not specify dependent variables in a predictive sense, nor does it report model performance metrics. As a result, the extraction cannot populate empirical ML fields (main_findings, ml_techniques) or sample/country breakdowns from the excerpt alone.
